raw.description:
A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset.

At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc).

Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action.

The Role

We are looking for a Tech Lead to join our engineering team. This role requires an ambitious technical leader who can architect scalable systems, navigate complex carbon data architectures, and drive engineering excellence. Moving beyond traditional software delivery, you will translate product vision into reliable technology, lead critical architectural decisions, and leave a lasting mark on our platform from day one.

  • Architect and scale a seamless B2B procurement platform, delivering an intuitive, enterprise-grade user interface designed for daily engagement and complex workflows.

  • Drive end-to-end technical strategy, design, and architecture, translating ambitious product requirements into performant, scalable features and microservices.

  • Lead by example with hands-on technical execution, authoring high-quality, maintainable code across our TypeScript, Node.js, and Next.js stack.

  • Cultivate engineering excellence across the team, providing high-impact mentorship, technical guidance, and rigorous code reviews to continuously elevate development standards.

  • Safeguard platform integrity, establishing robust security, reliability, and performance standards across our applications and core cloud infrastructure.

  • Partner closely with product, design, and cross-functional teams, evaluating trade-offs and technical permutations to engineer optimal, user-centric solutions.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of technical leadership (2+ years) guiding teams through complex, full-lifecycle product deliveries.

  • Deep technical proficiency in TypeScript and the Node.js ecosystem, alongside extensive hands-on experience building modern, data-dense interfaces with React or Next.js.

  • Strong architectural expertise in RESTful API design, backend systems architecture, and relational data modelling (PostgreSQL experience preferred).

  • Demonstrated commitment to engineering rigour, with a deep understanding of software design patterns, enterprise web security standards, and modern development workflows (Git, feature branching).

  • Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure and continuous deployment, including hands-on experience building and maintaining services on platforms like AWS.

  • Exceptional collaborative and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical decisions, bridge alignment across product teams, and mentor engineers.

  • Basic familiarity with Python is a plus, or a strong technical curiosity to expand into auxiliary parts of our data processing stack.


The hiring process

  • An intro call with the People Team

  • A Technical Interview with our SVP of Tech, Felipe

  • A Case Study with 2 Engineers from the team

What's in it for you at CEEZER?

  • A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets.

  • Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence.

  • True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it.

  • An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.

  • Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management.

  • A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate.

Create an impact with us?

We know that great talent doesn’t always follow a linear path. If your experience doesn't check every single box on this list, but you have the drive and unique strengths to excel here, we still want to hear from you.

Here, building a diverse team isn't a checkbox—It’s how we solve complex global challenges. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, skills, and potential, while actively working to keep unconscious bias out of our process. We’ve created an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone to thrive.

If you need any adjustments or specific accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We are here to support you.

About us

CEEZER is the leading partner for Climate Performance Asset procurement and management, empowering businesses to transform climate ambition into a clear path to net-zero. Trusted by major organizations including Deutsche Telekom, LGT, and Nasdaq, CEEZER provides the confidence needed to implement effective climate action strategies. For more information, visit .

Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores formam o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro por meio das suas marcas Mooz e GAVB. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.

Vem fazer beleza com a gente!

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Arquitetura e Integração de Sistemas: Atuar como arquiteto de sistemas e de produto dentro da squad jurídica, alinhando as necessidades de negócio às soluções de mercado.
  • Desenvolvimento Estratégico: Focar na realização de integrações sistêmicas, criação de conectores e desenvolvimento de AWS Lambdas, sem atuar com codificação pura do dia a dia.
  • Gestão de Banco de Dados: Elaborar e otimizar scripts para bancos de dados para sustentar as integrações e processos.
  • Gestão de Fornecedores e Produtos: Elaborar documentos de escopo e atuar fortemente na gestão de fornecedores, acompanhando a parametrização de sistemas externos.
  • Garantia de Qualidade e Homologação: Validar as entregas feitas pelos fornecedores durante as etapas de homologação para garantir que os desenvolvimentos atendam aos requisitos do negócio.
  • Negociação e Resolução de Problemas: Conduzir negociações constantes com fornecedores sobre prazos e prioridades, agindo proativamente na resolução de problemas ou frente a atrasos de terceiros.
  • Suporte e Evolução (Perfil Híbrido): Prestar suporte à produção após a implantação de ferramentas de mercado, atuando de forma híbrida tanto na criação de novas soluções quanto na evolução de arquiteturas já existentes.
  • Gestão de Débito Técnico e Infraestrutura: Identificar, tratar e monitorar débitos técnicos do ambiente (composto majoritariamente por soluções SaaS), garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e performance, além de gerenciar vulnerabilidades utilizando ferramentas como Dependabot.
  • Migração de Sistemas: Apoiar no processo de migração de sistemas legados para a nova plataforma arquitetural.
  • Colaboração Técnica: Realizar trocas arquiteturais e funcionais constantes com o Tech Lead da equipe, sem a necessidade de focar em revisões de código (code reviews) com outros desenvolvedores.
  • Acompanhamento Ágil: Conduzir a execução das atividades utilizando o modelo de trabalho definido (Business Map) para o acompanhamento das iniciativas e cards.
  • Participação Estratégica: Participar de agendas de trabalho para construção de escopos e homologações, contando com o suporte de profissionais especializados em agilidade da diretoria.

O que você precisa ter ou saber?

  • Boa capacidade de comunicação interpessoal, comunicação assertiva, resiliência e forte habilidade de negociação para resolver problemas e alinhar prazos com fornecedores externos.
  • Forte visão de arquitetura de sistemas e de produto, com foco em alinhar as necessidades do negócio às soluções de mercado (especialmente ambientes SaaS).
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas e criação de conectores para interligar diversas plataformas.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento serverless, especificamente com AWS Lambdas.
  • Experiência na elaboração de scripts para bancos de dados, incluindo a criação e execução de triggers, functions e procedures relacionais.
  • Experiência na elaboração de documentos de escopo, acompanhamento de parametrizações sistêmicas feitas por fornecedores e validação rigorosa de entregas durante as etapas de homologação.
  • Capacidade de atuar na identificação e gestão de débitos técnicos, garantindo segurança, escalabilidade, performance e tratamento de vulnerabilidades (ex: utilizando ferramentas como Dependabot).
  • Experiência em serviços de comunicação entre sistemas e APIs, como Rest, Restful, SOAP e API Gateway.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma híbrida: criando novas soluções e evoluindo arquiteturas já existentes para suportar a produção após a implantação das ferramentas.
  • Ser um entusiasta da cultura ágil, agir com empatia, trabalhar em equipe de forma colaborativa e ter pragmatismo para a resolução de problemas.

Você irá se diferenciar se tiver:

  • Contato com soluções/sistemas de Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro, Sistemas Jurídicos, Compliance e Riscos e Auditoria.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos base em Python, Node, React e NextJS, não para codificação contínua, mas para facilitar as trocas arquiteturais e funcionais com o Tech Lead e a equipe.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos e aplicações de Inteligência Artificial para otimização de processos (Exemplo: GenAI, LLMs, RAG, Fine-tuning).
  • Experiência com engenharia de dados.
  • Conhecimento em plataformas Low Code, como APPSheet.
  • Conhecimento em LGPD.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios que cuidam e se diferenciam:

No Grupo Boticário, o cuidado é a nossa base para atingirmos resultados exponenciais. Temos um portfólio com mais de 20 benefícios para cuidar da sua saúde, bem estar e família. Confira abaixo.

raw.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

​

Job Overview

The Data and Devices (D&D) business unit of TE Connectivity has an opportunity for a Product Manager to join the Power product team. The Power Solutions product portfolio includes Power supply, Internal Power, Distribution, and Busbar Assembly products. The focus of this position will be global support of our Busbar assembly product portfolio.
The Product Manager will oversee all aspects of a global product line or portfolio, encompassing new product development, manufacturing, marketing, and sales. The Product Manager manages the portfolio as a “mini” General Manager. They are responsible for overall product strategy, business leadership, and capacity planning to meet sales and gross (or standard) margin targets.
This role requires strong strategic thinking, experience working across regions, and a strong proactive work ethic. This role must collaborate closely cross-functionally with colleagues in Sales, Engineering, Operations, and Marketing to gain alignment and drive the successful execution of the product roadmaps.

Short Description

Market Sensing & Strategy Development:
• Articulate market trends, demand drivers, customer needs, industry trends, and competitive landscape
• Conduct market segmentation exercises to develop market segment-specific strategies.
• Conduct competitive analysis and benchmarking
• Define segment–specific value propositions that beat the competition
• Develop product roadmaps that align with business strategy
• Design a go-to-market strategy, inclusive of channel strategy and partnerships
• Work with R&D and operations in the development of new products to meet current and future customer requirements

• Manage the product lifecycle

Execution – New Product Development & Launch
• Be the opportunity champion for development projects
• Plans product launches, including the development of marketing and sales plans
• Provide demand forecast inputs to S&OP
• Attend customer meetings in support of winning new business

• Exercise thought leadership

Execution – Post Launch Product Management
• Manage the P&L (sales and gross or standard margin) for the assigned portfolio

• Deliver sustained profitable growth

  • Enable sales to promote the product line via training and the development of collateral materials that help articulate the value proposition
    • Manage special price requests
    • Track progress to the business plan and facilitate resolution of gaps
    • Be the champion for the resolution of product issues (e.g., quality, delivery, etc.)

.

What your background should look like:

Qualifications:
• 4-year technical or business degree required, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering degree preferred
• Prior P&L management experience is preferred
• Ability to travel domestically and internationally between 10% and 25%
• 3+ years of product management or technical sales experience

Additional Qualifications:
• Strong business acumen with an ability to understand technically complex concepts
• Creative and innovative thinker able to provide input on the development of the product strategies and the relevant business plans, with the ability to execute
• Proven ability to multitask and drive results in a dynamic, high-paced environment
• Strong interpersonal, planning, organization, and teamwork skills.
• Ability to influence cross-functional teams and to build strong relationships both internally and externally
• Advanced presentation skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex concepts to foster understanding and acknowledgement of critical information, both up and down the organization.

Competencies

Values: Integrity, Accountability, Inclusion, Innovation, Teamwork

ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat,Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

COMPENSATION
• Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $82,000 – $123,000 (subject to change dependent on physical location)
• Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity.
• Total Compensation = Base Salary + Incentive(s) + Benefits

BENEFITS
• A comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), disability, life insurance, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and voluntary benefits.

EOE, Including Disability/Vets

IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD
TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity never requests payment or fees from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.

raw.description:
Grants Associate, Resource Development

100% Remote within California, Must reside in California

FoundationCCC’s Resource Development Department seeks an experience Grants Associate who will be an effective contributor to a highly productive, quality-oriented, collaborative grants team. Working with program teams and other departments, the position researches, writes, and coordinates the development and submission of high-quality grant proposals, matching funder priorities with fundable projects. The Grants Associate develops and maintains systems for organizing and sharing information, including through Salesforce, Asana, and other digital tools. The position conducts prospect research to identify new funders and assess grant opportunities. The senior associate also assists in the broader work of the Resource Development Department. As needed, the Grants Associate guides the grants management team’s work on active grants, such as reports, modification requests, and funder stewardship.

What You’ll Do

This position is an opportunity for a mission-motivated, successful, and highly organized grant development professional to join a growing Resource Development Department within FoundationCCC’s Advancement Division. The Resource Development Department is responsible for the creation, development, and management of financial opportunities that advance the mission of the Foundation and the California Community Colleges. Resource Development supports the organization’s role as the system’s innovation hub; makes the case for, secures, centralizes, manages, and reports revenue generation for the organization; stewards gifts and grants; and manages the cultivation of our relationships with donors and grantors. In addition, the Resource Development Department administers the Strategic Support for Colleges and Scholars Program, which provides colleges with grants, scholarships, and emergency financial aid.

  • Gather information for, write, edit, compile, and submit very high-quality grant proposals, competitive contract bids, concept papers, and letters of intent that are persuasive, accurate, and carefully consistent with funder priorities, guidelines, deadlines, and other instructions.
  • Develop knowledge and understanding of FoundationCCC’s programs and services, and use this knowledge to effectively manage a portfolio of grants and develop cases of support for existing and new programs and projects.
  • Coordinate with internal and external program and project partners to identify potential funders and grant opportunities; develop timelines and work for producing grant proposals; plan and articulate outcomes, objectives, deliverables, and budgets; and design, write, and gather supplemental materials for grant application submission.
  • Research, understand, and track current and future grant opportunities, summarizing them and disseminating or promoting them internally, as appropriate.
  • Facilitate and track revisions to scopes of work, budgets, and key dates for grants, and keep key internal and partner stakeholders informed of these.
  • Support funder outreach and direct communications, including drafting emails to funders, preparing meeting agendas for calls with funders, and drafting funder profiles to inform engagement strategies.
  • Support with special projects and other duties within the Department, Division, and organization, as assigned.

Attributes for Success

  • Minimum of three (3) + years of work experience with demonstrated success
  • Minimum of two or three (2-3) years of related work and/or volunteer experience in submitting successful philanthropic, corporate, and/or government grant proposals
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience in an education or non-profit environment preferred
  • Familiarity with the community college system a plus
  • Familiarity with fundraising office administration (best practices, protocols, procedures, and record/data management).
  • Experience with the scaling and startup of programs preferred.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google Suite, Salesforce, Asana, and/or other digital systems, platforms, and tools that support collaborative work and fundraising is strongly preferred.
  • We’re recruiting for mission-driven, passionate, equity-minded individuals with a strong desire to impact and change people’s lives for the better
  • Our work holds great weight and responsibility, and the opportunity to impact the lives of millions
  • Innovation, creativity, collaboration, and entrepreneurship are encouraged as employees work to achieve organizational goals
  • FoundationCCC blends the impact of a non-profit, the culture of an entrepreneurial start-up, and the scale of a state agency
  • Team members are hired for their expertise in niche areas across our areas of impact and higher education overall, and for their knowledge of business, philanthropy, technology, communications, and more
  • We have a commitment to professional development and an emphasis on shared leadership, to ensure growth for employees and the organization overall

What we Offer

FoundationCCC is fully committed to a “remote-first” philosophy, and recruits and hires talent across the state in fully remote positions, where virtual work is possible. Our headquarters are located in Downtown Sacramento, just blocks from California’s State Capitol.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, generous PTO, holidays
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans, Flexible Spending Accounts, and Health Savings Accounts (HSA), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Wellness offerings
  • CalPERS retirement program and optional 403(b) and 457 Retirement plans
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness certified employer

If you have any questions, please email us at .

Budgeted Annual Salary Pay Range:

$75,000.00 - $85,000.00

Final salary and rates are based on education, experience, skills relevant to the role, and internal equity.

Industry: AI Infrastructure / Data Infrastructure / SaaS

About the Company

Our partner is a rapidly growing, venture-backed AI infrastructure startup building the technology that enables software companies to migrate customer data between complex systems quickly and reliably. Their platform automates one of the most difficult problems in enterprise software adoption—moving and transforming data across CRMs, ERPs, and other systems of record—allowing customers to onboard in hours instead of weeks.

The company has experienced exceptional growth, increasing revenue nearly 4x in the first half of the year, and is now scaling both its engineering and go-to-market teams. Their product sits at the intersection of AI, data infrastructure, and workflow automation, solving technically challenging problems for a growing customer base.

The Opportunity

Our partner is hiring Senior Full Stack Engineers to help build the next generation of their product. This is a backend-heavy product engineering role focused on developing customer-facing features, building scalable data movement systems, and solving complex engineering problems that directly impact customers.

This isn't an environment where engineers simply work through tickets. The team is looking for builders who enjoy shaping product direction, collaborating closely with customers, and using AI as a core part of their development workflow. You'll work alongside experienced engineers in a highly collaborative environment where ownership, initiative, and product thinking are expected from day one.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain full-stack product features with an emphasis on backend systems
  • Develop scalable data movement pipelines and workflow automation capabilities
  • Partner with product, engineering, and occasionally customers to solve real-world technical challenges
  • Contribute to product direction by providing thoughtful technical feedback and implementation ideas
  • Build AI-enabled product capabilities and incorporate modern AI tooling into daily development workflows
  • Write clean, maintainable TypeScript code across frontend and backend services
  • Help improve platform performance, reliability, and developer experience

Requirements

Nice to Have

  • 5–7+ years of professional software engineering experience (4 years minimum considered)
  • Strong experience building full-stack applications using TypeScript and React
  • Experience developing backend systems, APIs, and data-intensive applications
  • Product-minded engineer who enjoys solving customer problems—not just implementing requirements
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced startup environments with significant ownership
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools within your engineering workflow
  • Strong communication skills and willingness to collaborate across product and engineering teams
  • Experience with ETL, data movement, workflow orchestration, or pipeline development
  • Experience with browser automation, web scraping, or automation tooling
  • Experience working with AI agents or modern LLM frameworks
  • Familiarity with AWS, Postgres, or Temporal

raw.description:
The NISC IV program at Leidos has an opening for a Data Visualization Analyst with prior FAA or federal experience.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Power BI, PowerApps, and Power Automate to graphically display relevant data for analysis.

Specific duties for the position include:

  • Data Analysis and Metrics
    • Conduct quantitative and qualitative data analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
    • Develop and maintain performance metrics to track progress, compliance, and outcomes for FAA programs and offices.
    • Provide data-driven recommendations to support strategic decision-making and performance improvement.
    • Ensure accuracy, integrity, and reliability of data used for analysis and reporting.
  • Dashboards and Visualization
  • Design and develop visually appealing and intuitive dashboards, reports, and interactive visualizations to present complex data in a clear and concise manner.
  • Use data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or QlikView to create interactive and user-friendly reports.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify requirements and design solutions that communicate key insights effectively.
  • Stay current with best practices in dashboard development and visualization to enhance usability and accessibility.
  • Continuous Improvement and Knowledge Management
    • Research industry and other federal agency best practices and provide recommendations for improving program management, data analysis, and reporting practices.
    • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve data accuracy, and enhance efficiency using fundamental principles of Lean, Six Sigma, and Theory of Constraints.
    • Document lessons learned, processes, and standard operating procedures to support organizational knowledge retention.
    • Collaborate with management and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable visualization projects.
    • Use knowledge, skills, and abilities of a wide variety of advanced computer technologies and theories. Maintain an understanding of operations to identify data sources by owner, as well as presentation needs.

Additional responsibilities may include:

Program and Project Management

  • Support program and project planning, execution, monitoring, and reporting using scope, schedule, and cost management tools.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules, milestones, and deliverables in alignment with FAA requirements.
  • Track and report risks, issues, and dependencies, and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Prepare executive-level project briefings, decision memos, and reports that clearly communicate program status, risks, and recommendations.

Technical Writing and Executive Briefings

  • Develop, review, and edit technical documentation, project reports, and executive correspondence to ensure accuracy and clarity.
  • Create high-quality executive-level presentations and briefing materials for senior leadership, including complex data reporting.
  • Maintain consistency of style and messaging across all program and project deliverables.
  • Data Analysis and Metrics

Basic Qualifications:

  • BA degree and 8+ years of prior relevant experience or Masters with 6+ years of prior relevant experience. Will consider equivalent relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.
  • Proficiency in using MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, PowerApps, and Power Automate to design dashboards, automate workflows, and present analytical data.

This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform - not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You talk, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Chinese - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.

Do you switch between English and Chinese mid-sentence without even thinking about it? Rant about your day, discuss your favorite show, think out loud with different languages - say it exactly how you'd say it to a friend. What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities:

  • Record 1-2 minute voice clips responding to a prompt or reacting to a short video
  • Speak naturally, switching between English and Chinese the way you normally would in everyday conversation
  • Complete a few clips per recording session

Requirements

  • Language: Fully bilingual - fluent or native in both English and Chinese, and someone who naturally mixes the two when speaking
  • Equipment: Any device works, including your phone - no studio or special equipment needed
  • Recording environment: A quiet room with no background music, TV, traffic, or other people talking
  • Audio quality: Clear voice, close to the mic, one speaker only, no echo. A headset or earbuds with a mic helps but isn't required
  • Note: Quiet, clean audio matters most - background noise or unclear speech can affect approval

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

  • Get paid to talk - no perfect grammar, no formality: up to $5 per hour equivalent depending on the project
  • Do it from your couch, your phone, wherever's comfortable
  • Flexible, from home, paid per approved recording
  • If you naturally mix Chinese and English when you speak, you're exactly who we're looking for

Why North Memorial Health?

At North Memorial Health, you’re part of an inclusive health team that is rooted in our values: Advocate Courageously, Rally Together, Respect Uniqueness and Create Impact. Empathy and care are at the heart of North’s culture which is designed to actively support each team member’s wellbeing and growth. Our strength lies in our diversity, and we embrace the unique contributions and experiences of each person. Together, we empower patients to achieve their best health.

Our health system encompasses two hospital locations in Robbinsdale and Maple Grove as well as a network of 23 clinics which includes 13 primary clinics, 6 specialty clinics, 4 urgent care/urgency centers and emergency care offerings covering five counties. Our Robbinsdale Hospital, established in 1954, is a 385-bed facility recognized as the top Level 1 Trauma center for 25 years, as well as serving as a Level II pediatric trauma center. Our Maple Grove Hospital was established in 2009, is a 134-bed facility recognized as a top hospital in the state for Women and Children Care, with a Level III NICU, and is the largest Family Birth Center in the state (~5,000 deliveries per year and over 60,000 babies delivered). Both have been named to the 2022 Fortune/Merative 100 Top Hospitals® list, 2023 Women’s Choice Award Best Hospitals list.

Benefits the North Way!

As North Memorial Health is a non-profit organization you are eligible for the Public Student Loan Forgiveness program. Most part-time and all full-time positions are eligible for benefits.

  • Health & Welfare Benefit Packages
  • 401k Retirement Match or Pension Plan, based on workgroup eligibility
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) Plans
  • Adoption Reimbursement up to $3000 per child
  • Child Care Discount Program with New Horizon 10% off weekly childcare tuition
  • Education/Tuition Reimbursement

Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At North Memorial Health we recognize that the strength of our team lies in our diversity and make every effort to embrace the unique contributions and experiences of each person on our team. We strive to ensure that everyone feels like they are a valuable part of our community, with initiatives that reinforce our belief in diversity, equity, and inclusivity, to promote a workforce that enables authenticity, as we want to be our best when providing effective services to our patients. We acknowledge and celebrate the unique traditions, backgrounds, languages, beliefs, and customs of our community, and want everyone to feel welcome. Through our DE&I initiatives we hope to dispel myths, assumptions, and acts of implicit bias.

About this position

The Coder II accurately applies the correct ICD-10CM and CPT coding with appropriate modifiers, analysis and data entry performed on inpatient and outpatient's services in either the professional services or in hospital setting for billing customer accounts and ensures accurate clinical data base is maintained. POSTING DETAILS:

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Supervisor, Care Management - RCT to join our team! The Licensed Supervisor, Care Management - RCT oversees a team who provide integrated, whole-person care within a managed care environment. The Licensed Supervisor, Care Management – RCT would be expected to work and be available at their remote location between the hours of 8:30am – 5:00pm and be flexible to travel within the community for meetings as needed. The role is responsible for the supervision of staff, ensuring quality service delivery, compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards, and the effective coordination of care for members with complex needs. In addition, this role provides clinical supervision and guidance, applying professional licensure to support care planning, clinical decision-making, and resolution of complex member cases.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Supervise staff, including oversight of day-to-day responsibilities, performance management, development, and time and attendance.
  • Ensure staff utilize established workflows to complete comprehensive assessments and care plans for members.
  • Establish and maintain a team-based, person-centered approach to care coordination that addresses members’ physical, behavioral, and social health needs.
  • Monitor team performance metrics, caseload distribution, and quality indicators to ensure effective service delivery.
  • Provide coaching, education, and guidance to staff to support continuous improvement and professional development.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • Associate's degree (RN only) and three (3) years experience providing care management, case management, or care coordination to the MH/SU/IDD population; OR
  • Bachelor's degree (RN only) and three (3) years experience providing care management, case management, or care coordination to the MH/SU/IDD population; OR
  • Master's degree and fully licensed LCSW, LCMHC, LPA, LMFT, or RN and three (3) years experience providing care management, case management, or care coordination to the MH/SU/IDD population.
  • Fully licensed in the State of North Carolina as one of the following: LCSW, LCMHC, LPA, LMFT, LCAS or RN.
  • If applying with an Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree, you must be fully licensed in the state of North Carolina as an RN.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within Trillium’s catchment area of North Carolina, which includes the following counties: Anson, Bertie, Beaufort, Bladen, Brunswick, Camden, Chowan, Carteret, Columbus, Craven, Currituck, Dare, Duplin, Edgecombe, Gates, Greene, Guilford, Halifax, Hertford, Hoke, Hyde, Jones, Lee, Lenoir, Martin, Montgomery, Moore, Nash, New Hanover, Northampton, Onslow, Pamlico, Pasquotank, Pender, Perquimans, Pitt, Randolph, Richmond, Robeson, Sampson, Scotland, Tyrrell, Warren, Washington, Wayne, Wilson.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.

Preferred:

  • Degree in Human Services field.
  • At least one (1) year supervisory experience with two (2) or more staff.
  • Experience with an MCO, Health Plan, or managed-care care management.

Deadline for Application: Thursday August 27, 2026, at 11:59PM

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)
  • Licensure/certification information, if applicable

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

Trillium Health Resources is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and a drug-free workplace. All candidates must pass a drug test as a condition of employment.

raw.description:
A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset.

At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc).

Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action.

We are looking for an RFP Manager to join our team. Moving beyond traditional bid coordination, this role requires an operational partner to own the complete proposal lifecycle, structure complex cross-functional inputs, and convert technical solution details into winning enterprise proposals. You will combine commercial rigor with polished execution to ensure enterprise buyers experience high-impact, compliant deliverables at every stage of the evaluation process.

Your mission

  • Own the end-to-end RFP process, serving as the lead on RFP strategy formulation and strict timeline adherence to ensure on-time, high-quality submissions.

  • Rally cross-functional deal teams across Sales, Climate Strategy & Solutions, Operations, Supply, Risk, Legal and Finance to streamline deliverable workflows and align responses with client-specific requirements.

  • Analyze opportunity dynamics and competitive landscapes to translate complex operational capabilities into clear, high-converting client communications.

  • Develop and maintain a library of reusable content, templates, and proposal resources, enabling faster turnaround times and consistent pre-sales execution.

  • Conduct systematic win/loss post-mortems to identify operational improvements, using deal data to refine future proposal strategy alongside Sales.

  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to continuously elevate proposal templates and pitch materials.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of experience in bid management, proposal operations, or complex project management, with a track record of driving flawless execution on large enterprise tenders.

  • Exceptional project management capabilities and operational discipline, with the proven ability to structure complex deliverables under tight deadlines.

  • Highly analytical mindset with a strong command of data modelling and presentation tools (Excel/Google Sheets, Google Slides), capable of translating complex metrics into polished client-facing assets.

  • Polished verbal and written communication skills, with the executive presence required to confidently engage and align with senior stakeholders.

  • Fluency in English is required. German fluency is a bonus.

  • Understanding of the Voluntary Carbon Market is a plus.

The hiring process

  • An intro call with the People Team.

  • A call with Juliane Sterzl, CRO

  • Meeting with Matt Schmid, our SVP of Sales

  • Case study with Juliane Sterzl & Magnus Drewelies, our CEO & Founder

What's in it for you at CEEZER?

  • A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets.

  • Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence.

  • True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it.

  • An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.

  • Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management.

  • A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate.

Create an impact with us?

We know that great talent doesn’t always follow a linear path. If your experience doesn't check every single box on this list, but you have the drive and unique strengths to excel here, we still want to hear from you.

Here, building a diverse team isn't a checkbox—It’s how we solve complex global challenges. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, skills, and potential, while actively working to keep unconscious bias out of our process. We’ve created an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone to thrive.

If you need any adjustments or specific accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We are here to support you.

About us

CEEZER is the leading partner for Climate Performance Asset procurement and management, empowering businesses to transform climate ambition into a clear path to net-zero. Trusted by major organizations including Deutsche Telekom, LGT, and Nasdaq, CEEZER provides the confidence needed to implement effective climate action strategies. For more information, visit .

Job Description Summary

The Senior Manager, Total Rewards – United States and Canada (USCAN) responsible for the delivery of compensation programs and related total rewards policies and processes across the region. This role partners with HR, business, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to deliver market-competitive, equitable, compliant, scalable, and financially sustainable programs that support talent and business priorities.

This is a people-leader role reporting to the Global Total Rewards Solution and Partnership Leader. The position combines strategic business partnership, program design, operational excellence, and team leadership. The role also serves as the Total Rewards partner for assigned business segments, advising leaders on key rewards and compensation matters.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Support the design, governance, and evolution of base salary, variable compensation, and incentive programs across the United States and Canada, ensuring alignment with business strategy, talent priorities, market dynamics, and global Total Rewards principles.
  • Serve as the Total Rewards Business Partner for assigned business segments, advising business and HR leaders on Total Rewards strategies that support business performance, workforce plans, talent priorities and organizational change.
  • Support the application and maintenance of job architecture, including job families, sub-families, career levels, job profiles, job evaluation, levelling and providing strategic guidance for new and evolving roles, organizational changes, complex cases, and exceptions while ensuring consistent application and preserving the integrity of the global framework across the USCAN, and assigned global business segments.
  • Partner with Finance on compensation budgets, forecasts, cost modelling, workforce-planning assumptions, and the financial implications of Total Rewards recommendations.
  • Identify and recommend improvements to Total Rewards operating processes, tools, service standards, and ways of working to improve efficiency, consistency, and colleague experience

We're looking for a Head of Recruitment who can own hiring strategy and execution end to end for a fast-growing, globally distributed team. This role is built for a scrappy, systems-minded leader who knows how to recruit at scale for remote roles, move fast without sacrificing quality, and build repeatable hiring engines from the ground up.

We are specifically looking for someone based in Latin America with deep experience sourcing and placing LatAm talent across remote roles. You understand the Latin American talent market, know where to find strong candidates across executive support, marketing, technical, and operational functions, and can build pipelines that consistently deliver quality hires from the region.

This is not a passive leadership role. You will be hands-on, deeply involved in sourcing, process design, and closing critical hires. If you thrive in startup environments, know how to balance speed with judgment, and enjoy building recruiting infrastructure rather than inheriting it, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • High-ownership role with direct influence on company growth and talent quality
  • Opportunity to build and lead the recruitment function as the company scales

What You'll Work On

Recruitment Strategy and Leadership

  • Own the recruiting function end to end across internal and client-facing roles
  • Define hiring strategy, priorities, and execution plans aligned with business goals
  • Partner closely with leadership to forecast hiring needs and timelines
  • Set standards for candidate quality, speed, and hiring consistency across Latin American talent markets

Hands-On Sourcing and Hiring

  • Personally source and close critical roles across executive, marketing, technical, and operations functions with a focus on LatAm talent
  • Build and maintain high-quality pipelines across Latin America for remote roles
  • Leverage outbound sourcing, referrals, regional job boards, and creative sourcing strategies specific to the LatAm market
  • Conduct interviews, guide stakeholders, and drive offers through close

Process, Systems, and Scale

  • Design and refine recruiting workflows, scorecards, and hiring playbooks
  • Implement and optimize ATS and sourcing tools
  • Ensure consistent candidate experience across all touchpoints
  • Track recruiting metrics including pipeline health, time to hire, and quality signals

Team and Partner Management

  • Manage or mentor recruiters and sourcers as the team grows
  • Apply BPO-style discipline where helpful without sacrificing startup speed
  • Hold recruiting partners accountable to quality and performance standards

What You Bring

  • 10 or more years of experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, or staffing leadership
  • Based in Latin America with deep, current knowledge of the LatAm remote talent market
  • Proven experience hiring for remote roles across multiple functions from Latin America
  • Background in BPO, agency, or high-volume recruiting environments in LatAm is a strong plus
  • Startup experience with comfort operating in fast-changing, ambiguous environments
  • Strong sourcing instincts and willingness to stay hands-on
  • Confident communicator who can partner with leadership and influence hiring decisions
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills; Spanish fluency is a strong plus

Nice to Have

  • Experience building recruiting teams or functions from scratch
  • Deep network of LatAm talent across executive support, marketing, and technical roles
  • Strong data instincts around funnels, sourcing performance, and hiring outcomes
  • Experience sourcing across multiple LatAm countries including Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Brazil, or Chile
  • Experience placing LatAm talent with US-based clients or employers

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your experience recruiting Latin American talent for remote roles, and explaining how you have built or scaled a recruiting function from the ground up

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a builder who enjoys owning hiring outcomes, rolling up your sleeves, and shaping the talent foundation of a growing company from Latin America, this role gives you the authority, autonomy, and scope to make a real impact.

Overview

About the Role

At Mindpath Health, we’re on a mission to make mental health care more accessible and more human. As a national leader in mental health services, we empower our clinicians, support our teams, and prioritize care that helps people truly thrive.

The Patient Financial Clearance Representative is responsible for investigating and understanding mental health benefits and contacting patients to clearly communicate cost estimate information and counsel patients on their financial options.

Generating cost estimates will include pre-service investigation of mental health benefits and financial clearance activities, such as verifying eligibility, insurance benefits, carrier information and authorization requirements via phone call, online portals or fax, determining patient liability information such as co-payments, co-insurance, deductibles and out of pocket amounts, understanding appropriate mental health authorization/referral requirements for scheduled appointments, updating demographics data and/or informing patients of their financial responsibility before their appointments. He/she must demonstrate a positive demeanor, good verbal and written communications skills and professionalism in approach.

The Patient Financial Clearance Representative must consistently demonstrate the use of critical thinking skills, skilled communication and troubleshooting techniques as well as have excellent customer service skills. This position will have the ability to anticipate and respond to a wide variety of issues/concerns and ability to execute tasks efficiently and effectively. This position requires the ability to independently plan and organize numerous tasks as the position directly impacts patients care and reimbursement.

This is a fully remote (based in TX, NC, SC, or FL), full-time role (40 hours/week, Monday–Friday).

  • Verify In Network and Out of Network (if applicable) mental health eligibility, benefits and authorization requirements for patient using phone system, payer portal or fax.

  • Understand patient Copays, Coinsurances, Deductibles, Out of Pocket limitations, authorization requirements and Out of Network benefits
  • If a patient does not have Mental Health benefits or In Network benefits, patient contact is required to notify and counsel the patient on their financial options.

  • Verify eligibility, benefits and authorization requirements for existing patients when their insurance plan changes, including INN benefits, OON benefits and provider network status

  • Ability to problem-solve and prioritize work in a fast-paced changing environment
  • Other tasks as assigned by leadership

  • Ability to prioritize work, handle multiple tasks to completion and make decisions on which course to follow for a particular situation
  • Skill in reading and understanding documents such as training manuals written in English

Mindpath Health is redefining how mental health care is delivered. Today, we operate across six states, providing a full range of psychiatric and therapy services via in-person and telehealth appointments. Our team is deeply committed to supporting total health through compassionate, collaborative care.

Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world applications.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction, and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirements.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern web technologies and data processing tools, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI frameworks to enhance automation and problem-solving
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $37 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

About The Job

Students come to Berlitz not just to learn a language, but also to gain an understanding of the culture. As a part-time, Freelance Farsi Instructor, you will work in a diverse environment that offers you a flexible schedule and casual dress code. While working with your students, you will use the Berlitz Method of instruction to create an environment where students feel free to experiment with the language and motivate them to achieve their language goals.

We provide you with a flexible training course where you will learn how to perform the Berlitz Method. You will also gain access to our platforms and technology which will allow you to deliver successful instruction.

This is all you need! We provide the students and support; you provide the instruction.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare for your lessons by going through the provided material and deciding what should be taught and how it can be customized based on the student’s needs.

  • Your schedule is based solely on your availability. We ask that you commit to providing 15-20 hours per week.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Teaching experience is a plus but not required.
  • Expert-level Farsi, intermediate English.
  • Exceptional communication skills.

Technical requirements:

  • A minimum of 15 Mbps download speed / 15 Mbps upload speed.
  • A stable wired connection to the internet (Wi-Fi is not sufficient).
  • A PC or laptop running Windows 11 or higher, or macOS 11 or higher (Linux does not support our applications).
  • A USB headset and a camera.
  • For those living in areas where load shedding occurs, it is required to have a backup system to support your devices.
  • At least 2 GHz of base processing speed and RAM equal or above 8GB.

We offer:

  • As an instructor you can attend group language sessions free of charge.
  • Flexible scheduling to fit your personal needs (must keep original schedule for the first 3-4 months)
  • The ability to work from home, allowing you to save time and money on your daily commute.
  • Free intensive training of the Berlitz Method

Watch our video to find out more! “Becoming a Live Online Instructor”:

raw.title: Senior CRM Manager - Lifecycle & Retention
raw.excerpt: Join our expanding Product Growth team!  We're actively recruiting a Senior CRM Manager as we continue to scale at M-KOPA.
raw.description:
Join our expanding Product Growth team! We're actively recruiting a Senior CRM Manager as we continue to scale at M-KOPA. You'll build and scale the lifecycle systems that drive retention, upsell, and customer lifetime value for millions of everyday earners across Africa.

The Impact 💚

You'll design the retention and upsell infrastructure that turns first-time customers into long-term, high-value ones, driving measurable CLV growth while creating financial inclusion for Africa's traditionally excluded. We've already helped over 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit. It's your chance to be part of something that's transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

The Opportunity

🏗️ Build lifecycle CRM from the ground up: design and scale retention, repayment, and upsell programmes across 4 African markets (Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, Ghana), working with proprietary data from millions of customers and a unique distribution model (30,000+ field agents + 300 telesales)

💰 Own retention and upsell outcomes: your success is measured in CLV growth, retention and renewal rates, repayment behaviour, and upsell revenue

🎲 Bring fresh thinking: we want someone who pushes lifecycle beyond the standard playbook, gamification, loyalty mechanics, streaks, rewards, and other creative growth levers that make repayment and engagement genuinely enjoyable, not just another push notification

🎯 Nice to have, not required: we're curious whether you've also touched performance or paid marketing. We don't run that as part of Growth today, but understanding how it connects to retention is something we're actively thinking about, and your perspective could help shape where we take it

🚀 Go hands-on daily: build automated journeys, design experiments, analyse results, and scale what works

🏆 Global recognition: join a company named by TIME 100 as one of the world's most influential and by the Financial Times as Africa's fastest-growing for 5 consecutive years (2022-2026)

What You'll Do

You'll own lifecycle CRM strategy and execution end to end. Build automated customer journeys in CleverTap, run experiments on messaging and timing, analyse retention and repayment cohorts, and scale successful programmes across markets. Partner with Product, Commercial, and Operations teams to turn customer behaviour into retention and growth opportunities.

Your Core Responsibilities

  • Build and scale multi-channel lifecycle programmes: design onboarding, retention, churn prevention, and upsell journeys across SMS, WhatsApp, push, and in-app messaging

  • Design behavioural trigger-based upsell systems: move customers from entry products (smartphones/e-bikes) to higher-value bundles (digital loans, insurance, device protection) based on payment behaviour and engagement signals

  • Run rigorous experiments: A/B test messaging, timing, incentives, and offers with clear hypotheses and statistical rigour, then turn wins into repeatable playbooks

  • Own retention economics: track and optimise LTV, cohort retention, renewal rates, and upsell performance, translating insights into action

  • Scale what works across markets: turn successful experiments into documented frameworks that enable teams to execute retention initiatives across 4 African markets

Your Environment 💼

Tech Stack: CleverTap, Braze, MoEngage, or similar

Analytics: Mixpanel, Amplitude, Looker

Channels: WhatsApp, SMS, push, in-app messaging, telesales

What You Need

  • 6+ years building and scaling CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally in businesses where daily or weekly customer engagement drives retention and revenue.

  • You've built CRM systems, not just optimised them, whether migrating platforms (Mailchimp → Braze), designing journey architecture from scratch, or scaling programmes across markets.

  • You're hands-on in CRM platforms daily, personally building journeys in tools like Braze, CleverTap, MoEngage, , or Iterable.

  • You think in business outcomes, your achievements mention LTV growth, retention revenue, upsell rates, renewal improvements, not just open rates or engagement metrics.

  • You run rigorous experiments, designing tests with clear hypotheses, control groups, and measurable success criteria.

  • You bring fresh eyes to lifecycle marketing, someone who's introduced gamification, loyalty programmes, streaks, badges, or other non-obvious engagement mechanics into a retention strategy, and can talk about what worked, what didn't, and why.

  • Relevant backgrounds we're interested in: MVNO experience, super-apps with daily engagement models, mobile gaming with daily retention mechanics, prepaid subscription services, or B2C fintech/subscription businesses where high-frequency engagement drives the model.

  • Bonus, not required: exposure to performance or paid marketing (paid social, paid search, app install campaigns), and a point of view on how acquisition spend and targeting could connect to retention outcomes. This isn't something you'd own, we're just genuinely interested in how you think about it.

Location & Benefits

  • 🌍 Fully remote role within UTC -1 to UTC +3 time zones

  • 🤝 Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

  • 📚 Professional development programmes and coaching partnerships

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • 💚 Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

Our technology has created measurable change:

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.1 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided through clean energy products, with over 127,700 circular economy products provided

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Digital Marketing Specialist

Compensation range: $1,500 AUD - $2,500 AUD / Monthly

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an established technology business specialising in secure digital infrastructure and solutions that help organisations protect sensitive systems, information, and access. The company works on technically complex projects where reliability, security, and careful implementation are essential.

With a strong focus on innovation and long-term solutions, the business supports organisations as they modernise their technology environments and strengthen their digital capabilities. The team operates in a collaborative, specialist environment and values people who are technically curious, dependable, and comfortable working on complex challenges.

As the business continues to grow, this is an opportunity to join a forward-thinking organisation where your work will contribute to meaningful technology initiatives and the ongoing development of secure, reliable digital solutions.

Role Overview: The client is seeking a driven and strategic Digital Marketing Specialist with strong expertise in content creation. In this role, you will focus on end-to-end content creation, including whitepapers, articles, media releases, and video production. Operating as the visual and execution lead, you will take raw text, strategic direction, and instructions from leadership to design, format, and deploy engaging visual content across multiple digital and print channels. This role also blends SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) strategy, advanced HubSpot management, and end-to-end graphic design with data analytics and client advisory.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist in strategy and execution for both traditional SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) to maximize visibility across standard search engines and AI-driven platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude).
  • Produce visual assets—including webpages, brochures, whitepapers, and marketing materials—utilizing Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Express, and Canva.
  • Format, layout, and polish complex documents, such as tender documents and formal reports, ensuring consistent branding, typography, and professional presentation.
  • Be able to use HubSpot to a high level: setup tracking, email nurtures, dashboards.
  • Manage, track and report on performance using platforms such as Google Analytics, GA4, Looker Studio, and native ad platforms.
  • Build intuitive and actionable dashboards to monitor campaign success and surface insights.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitive analysis, and performance audits to identify opportunities and inform optimisations.
  • Develop client-ready reports, campaign dashboards for reporting and present campaign results, insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Foster strong, collaborative relationships with clients, acting as a trusted advisor on digital strategy.
  • Stay across the latest trends and innovations across SEO, paid media and digital marketing best practice.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to align campaigns with overall marketing strategies and business objectives.

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • 2–4+ years experience in a similar digital marketing role (agency or in-house).
  • Proven success in both SEO and Paid Media campaign strategy and execution.
  • Proven graphic design skills using Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Express and Canva (or similar) designing webpages, brochures, whitepapers, formatting tender docs and reports.
  • Video editing experience using Riverside FM, CapCut, or Premier Pro is valuable but not essential if graphic design skills are strong.
  • Proven ability to create high quality design assets including social tiles and technical diagrams.
  • HubSpot setup and management
  • Analytical mindset with strong experience creating dashboards and pulling actionable insights from data.
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts and projects with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Good English language skills Critical thinking and ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision are important qualities.
  • A collaborative and proactive team player with a positive attitude and thirst for knowledge and a strong attitude with maturity are priorities for the role.
  • Strong organisational and time management skills — able to juggle multiple deadlines.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

The counselor will speak with prospective participants from Canada, the United States, India, and other locations, understand their SAP background and career goals, explain the most appropriate program, and guide qualified candidates through consultation and enrollment. This is a consultative educational-sales role that requires honest program communication, disciplined follow-up, and consistent target achievement.

Because many prospective candidates are located in North America, the successful applicant must be comfortable working a night shift from India aligned with Toronto business hours. The exact schedule will be confirmed during the interview and may change with Canadian daylight-saving time.

  • SAP module training led by experienced instructors, with structured learning and SAP system practice were included in the selected program.

  • Experience converting Facebook or other digital-marketing leads and working with LeadSquared or a similar CRM.

  • Response time to new leads and percentage of leads contacted.
  • Number of completed consultations and qualified opportunities.
  • Follow-up completion, CRM accuracy, and lead-pipeline quality.
  • Consultation-to-enrollment conversion rate and monthly enrollment achievement.
  • Communication quality, compliance with program representations, and candidate handoff quality.

  • Remote work opportunity with exposure to international SAP career markets.
  • Competitive compensation based on relevant experience and agreed performance expectations.
  • Training on SAP program offerings, candidate qualification, consultation standards, and internal processes.
  • Professional-development opportunities in educational sales, SAP career pathways, and international lead management.
