Epoch Concepts LLC (Epoch) has been providing Market Research, Enterprise IT, and Cyber Security Solutions and Services to both commercial and government clients since 2006.

We are a value-added reseller focused on overcoming organizational challenges with solutions that don’t just address problems but also create opportunities and competitive advantages. Our core capabilities cover three major areas: Services, Solutions, and Integrations.

Based in Littleton, CO, Epoch works closely with industry leaders such as Cisco, HPE, Dell Technologies, Netscout, and Palo Alto, focusing on Federal Systems Integrators, USG, and Commercial Communities. Because of our strategic alliance with key distribution channels, Epoch is able to offer our customers access to over 2500 vendors. As a certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), Epoch is a valuable sole source provider of technology products and services. Our employees are our greatest assets, and we take pride in recognizing their outstanding talents and efforts.

Position Summary:

The Senior Account Executive is responsible for owning and growing our business across the SOF and COCOM community. This individual will serve as the primary point of contact for USSOCOM, JSOC, JCSE, and USSOUTHCOM, building trusted relationships with government stakeholders, program offices, and integrator partners to deliver IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud solutions that advance the mission.

The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of the DoD acquisition landscape with a proven track record of closing complex, multi-million-dollar technology deals. Familiarity with the SOF and COCOM operating environment preferred.

Who you are:

  • You are a relationship-driven sales professional with strong business development skills.
  • You excel at building trust with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • You communicate effectively with both technical and executive audiences.
  • You are self-motivated, organized, and able to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced federal sales environment and consistently deliver results.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the full sales cycle — prospecting, qualification, solution development, proposal, negotiation, and close — across the SOCOM, JSOC, JCSE, and SOUTHCOM account portfolio.
  • Develop and execute a territory and account plan that meets or exceeds an assigned annual bookings and revenue quota.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with government decision-makers, including CIOs, CISOs, program managers, contracting officers, and end-user commands.
  • Position Epoch Concepts' portfolio — infrastructure, storage, cybersecurity, cloud, and hyperconverged solutions — to address mission requirements and readiness objectives.
  • Cultivate and leverage relationships with OEM partners (e.g., Cisco, Dell, HPE/Aruba, Palo Alto Networks, Juniper, VMware, Pure Storage) and prime systems integrators to build winning solutions.
  • Navigate DoD procurement and capture activities using appropriate contract vehicles — ITES-4H, NASA SEWP, GSA, IDIQs, BPAs, and OTAs.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline, forecast, and account activity in the CRM and provide regular reporting to sales leadership.
  • Represent Epoch Concepts at industry days, command engagements, trade shows, and partner events.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal acquisition regulations, ethics rules, and company policies throughout the sales process.

What qualifications you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of federal technology sales experience supporting the DoD/DoW.
  • Experience selling into Special Operations Forces, Combatant Commands, or related DoD/DoW organizations preferred.
  • Established relationships within the SOF/COCOM community or a demonstrated ability to rapidly build them.
  • Proven history of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.
  • Knowledge of federal procurement processes and contract vehicles.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and consultative selling skills.
  • Experience with CRM systems and Microsoft Office.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience preferred.
  • Active Secret Security Clearance required; Active Top Secret or TS/SCI eligibility preferred.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% (primarily Tampa, FL (MacDill AFB), Fort Bragg, NC, and Miami/Doral, FL)

  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • 12 Paid Holidays

SiteDocs, a GoCanvas company, is a leading provider of digital safety management software, trusted by thousands of teams to modernize and simplify workplace health and safety across construction, engineering, infrastructure, logistics, and beyond. We’re the highest-rated EHS platform on Gartner-owned Capterra, empowering field teams and safety leaders to replace paperwork, boost compliance, and drive real-time visibility where it matters most.

SiteDocs is part of the Nemetschek Group — a publicly traded European software company with a multi-billion-euro market capitalisation. The group brings together more than 15 specialised brands, including GoCanvas, Bluebeam, FirmusAI, Nevaris, AllPlan, VectorWorks, and SpaceWell, serving customers across the full AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction & Operations) spectrum. Together, we’re shaping a smarter, safer, and more sustainable built world.

Position overview:
As the Director of Business Development you will own the pipeline creation engine supporting new logo growth across regions and brands. You will lead inbound and outbound business development, strategic and industry partnership motions, and the people and systems that turn market opportunity into qualified pipeline. You are responsible for pipeline volume, quality, conversion, productivity, and the development of future sales talent. You will build a modern, data-driven and AIforward organization that uses our technology stack, automation and practical AI agents to create leverage without sacrificing quality or customer experience. You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, RevOps, Analytics and Product to identify, test and scale the highest-return growth motions.


Your Most Important Initiatives:
  • Achieve qualified pipeline, meeting, conversion and sourced ARR targets across the Business Development organization
  • Own capacity planning, coverage and productivity for inbound and outbound BDR teams across regions and segments
  • Build, test and scale outbound plays by ICP, vertical, territory, use case and account profile; stop low-return motions quickly
  • Partner with Marketing on inbound conversion, campaigns, events, account-based programs and lead follow-up standards
  • Develop strategic, enterprise and industry partnerships that can produce repeatable customer acquisition and pipeline; stand up dedicated BDR pods around high-value partners when justified
  • Create clear service levels with Sales for lead acceptance, opportunity quality and follow-up, and use conversion data to continuously improve handoffs
  • Own the AI and automation roadmap for Business Development, including practical agents/workflows for account research, prioritization, personalization, sequencing, call preparation, follow-up, coaching and data hygiene
  • Drive adoption and effective use of Salesforce, Salesloft, Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and other approved revenue tools; eliminate redundant manual work where technology can do it better
  • Work with RevOps and Analytics to maintain dashboards, warning lights and weekly funnel views by source, region, segment, manager and rep
  • Run regular performance reviews focused on outcomes, conversion and coaching actions rather than activity for activity's sake  Recruit, onboard, certify and develop Business Development talent; create a strong internal bench and clear progression into sales roles
  • Coach managers and team leads to run effective 1:1s, call reviews, pipeline reviews and performance improvement plans
  • Maintain high standards for data quality, process compliance and ethical use of AI-generated content and automation
  • Monitor market, competitor and buyer changes and proactively adjust targeting, messaging and channel strategy
  • Present results, insights, experiments, risks and resource asks to the Chief Sales Officer and leadership team
  • Condense and synthesize critical information so successful plays, learnings and systems can be reused across the organization

What You Bring:
  • 5-10 years of experience in SaaS sales, business development, demand generation or a related high-growth environment, including meaningful people leadership experience
  • Proven success building and scaling inbound and outbound pipeline generation teams against clear pipeline and ARR goals
  • Experience managing managers or team leads, hiring strong talent, developing future sellers, and holding teams accountable to performance standards
  • Strong command of funnel economics: capacity, activity, meetings, accepted opportunities, conversion rates, pipeline creation and sourced revenue
  • Experience designing and launching new outbound, vertical, account-based or territory plays rather than only operating an existing motion
  • Experience building strategic, industry, association or technology partnerships that create repeatable pipeline and customer acquisition
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, RevOps, Analytics and Product to improve lead flow,targeting, messaging and conversion
  • AI-forward and automation-minded: practical experience using generative AI, workflow automation and agents to improve prospecting, research, prioritization, personalization, coaching or operational efficiency
  • Comfortable building simple AI agents and automated workflows independently using no-code/low-code tools, integrations and structured prompts; able to turn successful experiments into repeatable team processes
  • Strong working knowledge of modern revenue technology such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and enrichment/automation tools
  • Experience operating in a fast-changing, multi-region or multi-brand environment is an asset

Why Join Us?
Join a mission-driven team focused on proactive customer success and long-term partnership. You'll collaborate with supportive colleagues, impact business growth, and play a critical role in ensuring our customers thrive with GoCanvas & SiteDocs solutions.

Our success is rooted in a wonderfully wholesome culture, best defined by our four overarching values:
  • Authentic Relationships - People are never a means to an end.
  • Continuous Learning - Test every assumption and never stay stagnant.
  • Interdependence - We build systems that require everyone to perform with excellence, we are a team, and we succeed or fail together.
  • Data Driven Decisions - Because wisdom requires understanding the facts of the matter, disputes between competing perspectives are resolved with data.

What You Will Do:

The Senior Healthcare Payer Performance Analyst supports payer performance, reimbursement, and contract management initiatives through the analysis of complex claims, contracts, fee schedules, and reimbursement data. This role requires strong analytical judgment, healthcare reimbursement and contract expertise, and the ability to independently investigate issues, identify trends and opportunities, and translate complex data into actionable insights and recommendations.

The ideal candidate is a highly analytical problem solver who can synthesize information from multiple data sources, evaluate financial and operational impacts, perform root-cause analysis, and effectively communicate findings to internal stakeholders, leadership, and clients. Success in this role requires advanced Excel proficiency, intellectual curiosity, strong business acumen, and the ability to present complex concepts clearly.

In this role you will:

  • Analyze complex physician, facility, and ancillary contract terms, claims data, fee schedules, and reimbursement outcomes to support contract management, modeling, performance monitoring, and issue resolution.

  • Develop data-driven analyses to identify trends, variances, discrepancies, and financial or operational impacts related to payer contract performance and reimbursement accuracy.

  • Perform root-cause analysis using contract requirements, claim details, payment data, and operational workflows to distinguish contract configuration, interpretation, reimbursement, and claims-processing issues.

  • Use Excel and other business intelligence or analytics tools to organize, validate, interpret, summarize, and present complex healthcare data in support of reporting, issue resolution, and decision-making.

  • Lead analysis workstreams, synthesize findings, prepare clear deliverables, and present conclusions and recommendations to internal stakeholders, operational leaders, and other audiences as needed.

  • Partner with contracting, reimbursement, operations, analytics, and leadership teams to clarify requirements, resolve issues, and align contract terms, data outputs, and operational processes.

  • Manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy, attention to detail, sound judgment, and timely delivery in a data-intensive environment.

What You Will Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, finance, or a related field.
  • 5–7+ years of experience in healthcare data analysis, reimbursement analytics, contract management, managed care, revenue cycle, payer/provider contracting, or a related healthcare operations environment.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare reimbursement concepts, provider and payer contract language, fee schedules, contract interpretation, and how contract terms translate into data and payment outcomes.
  • Experience performing payment variance analysis, root-cause analysis, and issue resolution in a healthcare setting.
  • Advanced analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate large or complex data sets, identify actionable insights, and translate findings into practical recommendations.
  • Strong knowledge of medical terminology and healthcare coding concepts, including CPT, HCPCS, ICD, and revenue codes.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and Office proficiency, including experience organizing, analyzing, validating, summarizing, and presenting data; experience with business intelligence, reporting, or analytics tools is preferred.
  • Excellent written, verbal, communication, and presentation skills, including the ability to lead discussions, present analytical findings, and explain complex contract, reimbursement, and data concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, manage high-complexity analytical assignments, and communicate risks, findings, and recommendations effectively.

  • Experience with Epic

raw.description:
Job Summary

The Security TAM for Lightwell serves as a trusted advisor and Subject Matter Expert on Lightwell, while collaborating with engineering and product teams to resolve technical issues. The Lightwell Security Technical Account Manager is the interface between our Lightwell customers and our engineering teams.. They are key in accelerating software development lifecycles and OS patching with Red Hat Consulting, mentoring customer teams on security best practices, contributing to knowledge bases, and building solution patterns.

Please visit theRed Hat Lightwell page for more information.

What will you do:

  • Liaise with Red Hat Product Security, partners, and customer security and operations teams on security paradigms.

  • Facilitate customer use of the Lightwell clearinghouse for triage, patching, and backporting.

  • Provide best practices for consumption of Lightwell remediated libraries as part of our customer’s software development lifecycle alongside Red Hat Consulting.

  • Develop customer engagement plans, maintain environment documentation, and respond to support requests.

  • Partner with engineering, product management, and support teams to debug and resolve technical issues.

  • Mentor customer teams on security best practices and contribute to the Red Hat knowledge base.

  • Develop solution patterns to guide platform adoption and ensure long-term enterprise success.

What you will bring:

  • 10+ years of experience in a software development, security role, customer support,, engineering, or QA.

  • Demonstrated track record in a strategic advisory role to senior IT and business executives.

  • Applied knowledge of agile, scrum, and DevOps team methodologies.

  • Deep understanding of software supply chains, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD).

  • Advanced expertise in containerized application deployment (OpenShift, Kubernetes) and non-containerized deployment (Ansible/AAP).

  • Familiarity with image building (Docker, Podman) and version control methodologies (git).

  • Experience with artifact repository tools (Red Hat Quay, JFrog Artifactory, Sonatype Nexus, uDeploy).

  • Hands-on knowledge of workflow tools (Jenkins, GitLab Pipelines, GitHub Workflows, OpenShift GitOps, Red Hat Pipelines).

  • Advanced knowledge of unit testing basics (JUnit, pytest) and governance automation checks.

  • Understanding of library versioning (semver) and the broader Java ecosystem.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills to convey complex technical information concisely.

  • Associate's, Bachelor's degree, or higher in computer science or a technical discipline.

  • Willingness to travel internationally and to customer locations as required.

  • Executive presence and communication skills in English and French (native).

Nice to have:

  • Passion for open-source software and the Red Hat technology portfolio.

  • Previous experience as a developer, consultant, or solutions architect.

  • Red Hat Certified: RHCE (RHCA preferred)

  • Relevant security certification (CISSP, CCSP, CompTIA Security+, CC, CEH).

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterpriseopen source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Inclusion at Red Hat
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.


Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.


Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email . General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.
